  - *Captain Hannum* – referenced on 18 Dec 1666 (“…[Captain Hannum](http://…/10194)…”).

- **Measurements and units:**  
  - *6 _d._* – “…he giving 6 _d._ towards the boat…”.  
  - *100 _l._* – multiple occurrences: “…bespeak 100 _l._ of plate…”, “…paid for the plate…100 _l._”, “…100 _l._ to … Captain Cocke’s gift …”.  
  - *3 _l._* – “…3 _l._ per annum…”.  
  - *94 _l._* – “…plate … value of 94 _l._”.  
- **Dates and date references:**  
  - Daily entries: 1 Dec 1666 through 31 Dec 1666.  
  - Specific references:  
    - “2nd of September” – the fire’s outbreak.  
    - “3rd of September” – plot for burning the city.  
    - “October ten days” – rain.  
- **Other entities (non–naval):**  
  - *Sir W. Warren* – “—who I do every day more and more admire….” (10 Dec 1666).  
  - *Sir W. Batten*, *Sir W. Pen*, *Sir R. Viner* – various references.

**Page:** Diary entries from December 1666 (The Diary of Samuel Pepys) — https://www.pepysdiary.com/diary/1666/12/  

**Evidence:**  
- **Naval figures (names introduced):**  
  - *Captain Cocke* – referenced on 10 Dec 1666 ("…and then [Captain Cocke](http://…/3164), with whom I walked…") and 13 Dec 1666 (“…from the ’Change to [Captain Cocke’s](http://…/3164)…”) and 14 Dec 1666 (“…and the ‘Name of the sad a President…and that was one [Captain Cocke]; same…”) and 15 Dec 1666 (“…[Captain Cocke’s](http://…/3164)…”) and 22 Dec 1666 (“…to the office … [Captain Cocke](http://…/3164)…”).  
  - *Captain Batters* – mentioned on 18 Dec 1666 (“…[Captain Batters](http://…/7787) … drowned…”) and 17 Dec 1666 (“…[Captain Batters](http://…/7787) …”) .  
  - *Captain Robinson* – referenced on 29 Dec 1666 (“…[Captain Robinson’s](http://…/10676)…”) .  
  - *Captain Hannum* – referenced on 18 Dec 1666 (“…[Captain Hannum](http://…/10194)…”).  
  - *Captain (no further surname)* – “…[Captain](http://…/3164)…” appears multiple times, but specific names listed above.  
- **Measurements and units:**  
  - *6 _d._* – “…he giving 6 _d._ towards the boat…”.  
  - *100 _l._* – multiple occurrences: “…bespeak 100 _l._ of plate…”, “…paid for the plate…100 _l._”, “…100 _l._ to … Captain Cocke’s gift …”.  
  - *3 _l._* – “…3 _l._ per annum…”.  
  - *94 _l._* – “…plate … value of 94 _l._”.  
- **Dates and date references:**  
  - Daily entries: 1 Dec 1666 through 31 Dec 1666.  
  - Specific references:  
    - “2nd of September” – the fire’s outbreak.  
    - “3rd of September” – plot for burning the city.  
    - “October ten days” – rain.  
- **Other entities (non–naval):**  
  - *Sir W. Warren* – “—who I do every day more and more admire….” (10 Dec 1666).  
  - *Sir W. Batten*, *Sir W. Pen*, *Sir R. Viner* – various references.  

**Missing:**  
The page does not provide any information on a naval figure that appears in *all* December entries *except* for December 1668. It contains no edge‑case such as an absence in that particular month.

- *Captain Batters* – `https://www.pepysdiary.com/encyclopedia/7787/`.  
- *Captain Robinson* – `https://www.pepysdiary.com/encyclopedia/10676/`.  
- *Captain Hannum* – `https://www.pepysdiary.com/encyclopedia/10194/`.
